# Release Notes

## 0.45.4 - 2026-11-15 (deployed)

PR #89 deployed runtime SHA `00bbcce7f35ea0c5042915eb70daf5503dd82d29` to `production` on **2026-11-15**. Exact-main validation `43740158393` and approved production run `43740828643` passed, including immutable artifact validation, encrypted off-host backup, deployment/readback and promotion. Deployment evidence records `deployed_at_utc=2026-11-15T17:29:21.742598+00:00` and readback `passed`.

PATCH: repairs the existing paid-binding/access contract; no new price, bonus duration, renewal policy, product capability or financial-confirmation terms.

Confirmed payment is not itself active access. Activation requires usable authorization and the reserved entitlement; recovery applies that same payment exactly once, prefers the latest valid rebind mandate, and preserves manual access, trial consumption, refunded/revoked payments and superseded mandates. Duplicate invoices and consumed consent are blocked before provider invocation. Reconciliation uses the existing beat task with persisted exponential cooldown and at most eight attempts; this is activation recovery, not permission for another debit.

Recorded candidate evidence: Django suite 1196 tests OK (83 skipped), 151 targeted backend tests, 35 signed-return tests plus Chromium acceptance, partner browser acceptance and independent Spec/Quality review passed. Required main CI including the real isolated PWA route passed. Isolated fixtures are not production payment acceptance. Generic local Compose boot/readiness remains BLOCKED by missing worktree `.env`; no secrets were copied. Previous unrelated recognition/photo/provider/review, effective recognition flags, real-device and named R10 acceptance warnings remain unchanged; formal historical acceptance gaps are not waived.

**No live new payment, real bank-card retry, end-user production retry/bonus activation, or bank refund settlement was observed by this verification.** Guarded production readback used PostgreSQL READ ONLY, blocked provider/network calls and preserved snapshot counts: one paid payment / 1 UAH and ten refunded payments / 10 UAH. Existing manual incident access through 2027-02-12 remained intact. Two unresolved claims were all guarded out, not failed eligible activations. The read-only probe found the task registered and one schedule entry with the recovery source call; the probe itself did not invoke it. Separate bounded production readback confirmed seven source hashes and all six changed runtime source/template hashes against exact Git `00bbcce7f35ea0c5042915eb70daf5503dd82d29`; these sets overlap and are not thirteen distinct files. Public `/app/` returned 200 with the `paid_activation_pending` marker (release headers were empty). All six application containers were healthy/running. In the bounded last-15-minute logs since newly created containers, beat sent reconciliation three times and the worker received and succeeded three times, with no traceback. This proves bounded worker/beat liveness and actual task execution, not eligible-claim activation or live payment success.

See `code/docs/releases/0.45.4-billing-lifecycle-recovery.md`. Documentation merge SHA is distinct from the deployed runtime SHA; this synchronization requires no runtime rollout.

## Product Rules

### Release 0.45.4 lifecycle recovery

Confirmed payment is not itself active access. Activation requires usable authorization and the reserved entitlement; recovery applies that same payment exactly once, prefers the latest valid rebind mandate, and preserves manual access, trial consumption, refunded/revoked payments and superseded mandates. Duplicate invoices and consumed consent are blocked before provider invocation. Reconciliation uses the existing beat task with persisted exponential cooldown and at most eight attempts; this is activation recovery, not permission for another debit.

`access.activation_state` is `active`, `not_started`, `payment_pending` or `paid_activation_pending`. `recommended_action=continue_payment` is only for an unpaid existing invoice with an action URL; pending recovery otherwise uses `check_activation`. Consumed consent returns `billing_consent_consumed` before provider calls; a definitive failure permits a separately consented retry. Signed return refreshes the fresh-browser PWA state and never equates paid with active.

### Release 0.45.4 billing activation state

`access.activation_state` is `active`, `not_started`, `payment_pending` or `paid_activation_pending`. `recommended_action=continue_payment` is only for an unpaid existing invoice with an action URL; pending recovery otherwise uses `check_activation`. Consumed consent returns `billing_consent_consumed` before provider calls; a definitive failure permits a separately consented retry. Signed return refreshes the fresh-browser PWA state and never equates paid with active.
